source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-14

procedures.title: Door glass run channels: remove and install
steps: Adjust the channel as described under Doors - Adjustments - Door Windows.

procedures.title: Window regulator, manual: remove and install
steps: Removal: Take off the trim panel.
Remove the 2 sash bolt-and-nut assemblies that hold the window glass.
notes: Parts identification: figure 35 in the manual.
Figure 26 in the manual shows removing the inside window crank handle with tool J-7797: push the tool in the arrow direction to disengage the retaining spring.
